titleOriginal: 梧桐引凤，鹊渡银河丨七夕主题套装将登场
corrections: The existing unknown acquisition fields omitted an explicit individual 300-Echo-Bead price.
Xue Yue Ning Guang is not exclusively gift-only: it is individually purchasable, owned in 皎月同辉, and gift-only within 绯云共影.
Existing released statuses were supported only by a pre-release announcement and are corrected to announced with confirmation pending.
No actual game availability, Global identity or official EN/KO names established.

galleryDecision.reason: The final paired accessory panel explicitly prints 风花衔影 beside pink and 雪月凝光 beside blue. Matched bird-shaped top, pagoda cage, floral decorations and flame to the two full character photographs. Female pink view leads its gallery; the blue source has a male view only. Each gallery also retains its named panel as a precisely recorded source extract. Full character composition is preserved in enlargement, and all original URLs remain accessible.
